explained.summary: A fragment Marcus copied, source unknown: no joining in with other people’s wailing, no violent emotion. It’s a reminder to himself not to get swept up in the crowd’s grief or outrage. That doesn’t mean being cold. It means keeping his footing while others lose theirs.
explained.today: When a group chat spirals into panic about a rumour, or the office joins in moaning about a change, you can stay sympathetic without adding your own voice to the chorus.
